CPU denial of service from a crafted RSA key in a JWK; no forged certificate. No fixed v3 release, and step's go.step.sm/crypto still uses v3 (v4 is raised to the fixed 4.1.6 in the same image). step-ca is reached only from the internal pki network (Traefik, the bootstrap step, the renewers); the worst case is a stalled CA, visible through its health check. The weekly scan and Dependabot show when upstream moves.

LLM trial on the Spark (docs/architecture/llm-trial.md), served on the internal llm network only: no port, no way out, reached only from an admin SSH session. ffmpeg decodes audio and video for multimodal requests; the trial's model is text-only and no such request is sent. Fixed in ffmpeg 9 (one without a fix); NVIDIA's 26.10 is its latest vLLM image. The trial's Compose file goes when WP5b.1 brings the real serving.
